extraction.name: TravelPlanner
extraction.description: A new planning benchmark that focuses on travel planning, a common real-world planning scenario. It provides a rich sandbox environment, various tools for accessing nearly four million data records, and 1,225 meticulously curated planning intents and reference plans.
extraction.creator: Jian Xie, Kai Zhang, Jiangjie Chen, Tinghui Zhu, Renze Lou, Yuandong Tian, Yanghua Xiao, Yu Su
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data is sourced from publicly available Internet data and APIs, including Kaggle datasets and Google APIs, to create a static and closed sandbox environment. The data is then modified to suit the benchmark's requirements.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Kaggle Flight Status Prediction dataset, Google Distance Matrix API, Kaggle Zomato Restaurants Dataset, Google Places API, and Kaggle Airbnb Open Data Dataset.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: Prices were generated by multiplying the 'Distance' by a random factor ranging from 0.2 to 0.5 for flights, and by factors of 1 and 0.15 for 'self-driving' and 'taxi' modes, respectively.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Data was modified by adding, deleting, and altering certain keys and values to avoid data contamination. Restaurants and accommodations were randomly assigned to various cities, and random categories (e.g., cuisines, room rules) were assigned to them.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Specific fields like 'FlightDate', 'DepTime', 'ArrTime', 'ActualElapsedTime', 'Distance', 'OriginCityName', and 'DestCityName' were extracted while discarding other values.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: 20 graduate students were invited to meticulously annotate plans for synthesized queries. A plan was deemed eligible only if it met all constraints outlined in the evaluation script. The authors performed a detailed review of every query and plan, rectifying any errors found, and re-calibrated each query's budget using the costs from corresponding human-annotated plans.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The authors performed a detailed review of every query and plan, rectifying any errors found. One plan is deemed eligible only if it meets all the constraints outlined in the evaluation script.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: TravelPlanner aims to provide an effective benchmark for complex planning in future research, acting as a catalyst to enhance agents' performance in increasingly complex scenarios, hill-climbing towards human-level cognitive capabilities.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Some data is derived from publicly available Internet data and does not represent the authors' viewpoints. The evaluation criteria for commonsense are based on the authors' consensus, acknowledging that everyone's definition of commonsense may be different.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The data in the sandbox is based on 2022, which may cause agents to fail if they use incorrect dates. The definition of commonsense is based on authors' consensus and may differ from others.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating language agents in tool-use and complex planning within multiple constraints (Training, Validation, Testing). Evaluation feedback can be used in the training set (e.g., reinforcement learning), but cheating in the validation and test sets is strictly prohibited.
